description: A well-presented double en-suite room is now available in a clean, comfortable and professionally managed shared house. Situated in a convenient location close to local shops, supermarkets and excellent transport links, this property is ideal for a working professional looking for quality accommodation at an affordable price. The room is bright, spacious and fully furnished, offering a comfortable and private living space. It benefits from its own modern en-suite bathroom, providing added convenience and privacy. Finished in neutral décor, the room is ready for immediate occupation.
